graduation.note: Until every bar is met these picks stay off the curated boards and out of the headline record. Promotion is a deliberate human step, never automatic.
graduation.power_disclosure: These bars are a FLOOR, not proof of an edge. At this desk's volume (100 settled picks is more than a full season of them) the sample still cannot tell a +3% edge apart from zero -- that needs thousands of bets. Clearing the bars means the settlement works, the calibration has a real sample, and the desk is not bleeding; it opens a human review whose actual evidence is closing-line value, not this ROI.

note: EXPERIMENTAL -- tracked, not featured. These edges are recorded to build a settled record and are deliberately absent from every curated board until they have one. Our own walk-forward puts this model at 0.7034 accuracy / 0.1907 Brier (n=617) in the in season regime it is in today -- no better than a sharp closing line, which is exactly why every probability is shrunk hard toward the book and only genuine divergence survives. Moneylines only; no spreads, totals, or player props.
